# 'edge' Dialect

_面向边缘/机器人/VLA 部署的高层计算图方言._

EdgeDialect 是一个图层 (graph-level) 方言, 承载神经网络算子 (Conv / Matmul /
Relu / Attention 等), 用于在 lowering 到 Linalg 之前做计算图优化:
算子融合, 常量折叠, 量化, 内存规划. 设计上对标 TPU-MLIR 的 top/tpu 方言.

[TOC]

## Operations

### `edge.attention` (edge::AttentionOp)

_缩放点积注意力 softmax(QK^T*scale)V_

Syntax:

```
operation ::= `edge.attention` $query `,` $key `,` $value attr-dict `:` functional-type(operands, results)
```

Transformer/VLA 策略网络的核心算子. 后端可 lowering 为 FlashAttention 风格
的融合 kernel, 这是机器人推理延迟优化的关键路径.

Traits: `AlwaysSpeculatableImplTrait`

Interfaces: `ConditionallySpeculatable`, `NoMemoryEffect (MemoryEffectOpInterface)`, `ShapeInferenceOpInterface`

Effects: `MemoryEffects::Effect{}`

### `edge.conv_bn_relu` (edge::ConvBnReluOp)

_融合算子: Conv2D + BatchNorm + ReLU_

Syntax:

```
operation ::= `edge.conv_bn_relu` $input `,` $weight `,` $bias attr-dict
              `:` functional-type(operands, results)
```

将 conv2d -> batch_norm -> relu 三个算子融合成单算子, 减少访存与 kernel 启动
开销. TensorRT 的 ConvBNReLU 融合, TPU-MLIR 的 conv+bn 折叠都是同一思想.

Traits: `AlwaysSpeculatableImplTrait`

Interfaces: `ConditionallySpeculatable`, `NoMemoryEffect (MemoryEffectOpInterface)`, `ShapeInferenceOpInterface`

Effects: `MemoryEffects::Effect{}`

## Types

### QuantTensorType

_携带 scale/zeroPoint 的量化张量类型_

Syntax:

```
!edge.qtensor<
  ::mlir::RankedTensorType,   # tensorType
  ::mlir::FloatAttr,   # scale
  int64_t   # zeroPoint
>
```

`!edge.qtensor<tensor<1x3x224x224xi8>, 0.0078125, 0>` 表示一个 INT8 量化张量,
其反量化公式为 real = scale * (q - zeroPoint).

#### Parameters:

| Parameter | C++ type | Description |
| :-------: | :-------: | ----------- |
| tensorType | `::mlir::RankedTensorType` |  |
| scale | `::mlir::FloatAttr` |  |
| zeroPoint | `int64_t` |  |
